nodes.title: SG-5.3.1 · Scene start plays the authored fade transition
nodes.body:
Context: bedroom.yaml authors a transition effect (fade, 400 ms) but buildEffects skips it and BootScene.create never calls EffectRenderContext.playTransition, so no fade plays. Desired behavior: scene start plays the fade using the content duration, and plays nothing when the scene has no transition entry. Why: the transition must be content-driven, as required by the layered scene renderer goal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene with a fade transition entry, when the scene starts, then playTransition is called once with the entry durationMs
- Given a scene with no transition entry, when the scene starts, then playTransition is never called


## Scope
- In scope: Engine helper that plays the authored transition
- In scope: BootScene.create wiring
- In scope: Unit tests with a mocked context
- Out of scope: New transition kinds
- Out of scope: Changing dust or ambientLight effects
- Out of scope: Changing the bedroom.yaml content
- Preserve: buildEffects skipping transition specs
- Preserve: createPhaserEffectContext.playTransition using cameras.main.fadeIn
- Preserve: Existing BootScene effect cleanup on SHUTDOWN


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Engine code stays free of Phaser imports and uses the injected EffectRenderContext


## Definition of done
- Both requirements are met and their unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · An engine helper plays the scene's authored fade via the render context
nodes.body:
Context: src/engine/buildEffects.ts filters out transition specs and nothing else reads them. Desired behavior: a helper playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) finds the transition effect in scene.effects and calls ctx.playTransition(durationMs) once, or does nothing when absent. Expected result: the content duration reaches the context. Why: keeps the runtime free of hardcoded durations.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene whose effects include {type:'transition',kind:'fade',durationMs:400}, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is called once with 400
- Given a scene with effects but no transition entry, or no effects key, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is not called


## Scope
- In scope: New helper in game/src/engine
- Out of scope: Phaser code
- Preserve: buildEffects behavior


## Technical constraints
- Use EffectRenderContext and SceneDef types from the engine and state modules


## Definition of done
- Helper exists and is covered by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene.create plays the authored transition on scene start
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create builds effects via buildEffects(createPhaserEffectContext(this), scene) but never plays the transition. Desired behavior: create() builds the context once and also calls playSceneTransition with the same context and scene. Expected result: a fade plays when the scene starts. Why: the visible fade transition is part of the goal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create runs with a scene that has a fade entry, when the context playTransition is observed, then it is called once with the content durationMs
- Given BootScene.create runs with a scene lacking a transition, then playTransition is not called


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: effectContext.ts changes
- Preserve: Subscription and SHUTDOWN cleanup
- Preserve: sceneReady emission


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90


## Definition of done
- BootScene wired and unit tested


## Clarifying questions
- None
